Spatial Coverage Extent of PISCO

Source: R/config.R
pisco_extent.Rd

Returns the official geographic bounding coordinates for the PISCOp v3.0 domain, covering Peru and its transboundary hydrologic basins (2 deg N to 19 deg S, 64 deg W to 82 deg W).

Usage

pisco_extent(format = c("vector", "bbox", "ext"))

pisco_bbox()

Arguments

format

Character. Output format: "vector" (named numeric vector c(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax)), "bbox" (sf::st_bbox object), or "ext" (terra::ext object). Default is "vector".

Value

A named numeric vector, sf::st_bbox, or terra::ext representing the domain boundaries.

Examples

pisco_extent()
#> xmin ymin xmax ymax 
#>  -82  -19  -64    2 
pisco_extent("bbox")
#> xmin ymin xmax ymax 
#>  -82  -19  -64    2 
pisco_extent("ext")
#> SpatExtent : -82, -64, -19, 2 (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax)
